scheme_name: SAHAKAR MITRA: NCDC’s Scheme on Internship Programme
other_conditions: Applicant must hold a Bachelor’s degree in Agri/Dairy/Animal Husbandry/Veterinary Sciences/Fisheries/Horticulture/Textiles/Handloom/IT from a UGC/AICTE/ICAR‑recognized university, as recommended by the Head of Department

Applicant may be pursuing or have completed MBA Agri‑Business, MBA Coop, M.Com, MCA, MBA Finance, MBA International Trade, MBA Forestry, MBA Rural Development, MBA Project Management, Inter ICAI, or Inter ICWA, as recommended by the Head of Department
A person cannot be taken as an intern more than once
Maximum of two interns per year allowed from a specific institution
Each Regional Office can host a maximum of two interns simultaneously
Overall limit of 60 interns annually across all locations
benefits_summary: Interns receive a total stipend of ₹45,000 for the four‑month programme, comprising ₹10,000 per month and a ₹5,000 lump‑sum for report preparation.
